lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg18Ga2 (reduced formula Mg9Ga) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies two distinct close-packed-like local arrangements: Ga centers have 12 Mg neighbors (3.1485–3.2047 Å), while Mg environments show 12 neighbors comprising 2 Ga and 10 Mg (3.1485–3.2385 Å). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corner, edge, and face contacts, and Ga–Mg pairs sharing edges and faces.
